dsVersion: Not available: Figma REST versions endpoint returned 401 (no valid token). Read live through the Desktop Bridge on 2026-10-29; AI contract page dated 02 Oct 2026 (decisions 12 Oct 2026). Rebuild when the DS changes.
notes: Variables: Colors (primitive, mode Value), Customize Theme (semantic, Light/Dark; default Light), Typography (Default/Compact).
No spacing token above 48 px (marginXXL / paddingXXL / sizeXXL). Odd steps exist: Size/Spacing/spacing2, spacing6, spacing10.
Text style IDs end with a trailing comma; keep it when calling setTextStyleIdAsync.
Body Strong roles are named */Medium in the file (Base/Medium, Small/Medium, Large/Medium, Extra Large/Medium); Base/Semibold (600) and Base/Code (Roboto Mono 12/20) also exist.
AI contract says colorIcon is 45% black; the Customize Theme variable resolves to opacity-100 (#000000) in Light. Flagged as an open question, not changed.

counts.icons: 797 components on the Icon page (not listed)

typographyRoleTable.evidence: No DS page-header component. Closest DS uses of a 24px title: Result title, Empty State Block title, Topbar logo text = Title/Heading 3. See hydra-ux-patterns.md for what modules use in practice.
Cards page: 'Product Name' card heading = Title/Heading 4 (x2). Weak evidence; no DS section component.
Modal title, Drawer title, ExportCard title, Sidebar product name, Topbar tagline all use Title/Heading 5.
Default text in Menu, Breadcrumb, Input, Select, Table cell, Modal body.
Modal/Alert/Steps/Result/Popconfirm description layers = Base/Normal; colour carries the role.
Input 'Required' label, Stat Tile label = Base/Normal.
Button set: Base/Normal x25, Large/Normal x15.
Small Tag/Select sizes; card meta line 'Section ... | Page' = Small/Medium.
Tag set: Base/Normal x36, Small/Normal x4.
Alert title = Large/Medium; Popconfirm title = Base/Medium.
Stat Tile value and Statistic number = Title/Heading 3.
